comments.author: Hakad
comments.body_html:
Amazing mod! but IMO there are some things that’ll make this mod even better.

  1. An option to take foldable stocks into consideration on weapon length calculation, for example if I set the minimum weapon length to 3 blocks, I can just fold the stock on a 4 block long gun and put them into the holster, and then unfold it in the slot, it would be great if it regards stock length as well (either by making holstered weapon unable to fold/unfold, or calculate stock length before length settings etc.)
  2. It would be great if there’s options for always allowing pistol in the holster, for example if I set the gun minimum length to 3, majority of silenced pistols can no longer be holstered.

comments.author: yung_.
comments.body_html:
I do actually have the foldable stock function in mind but pull that out last second. Since I was not sure how the fold state should affect the player experience. I’ll probably just add everything I have in mind and make it a user toggle, stuff like dropping the gun if unfolded, decrease ergo on primary and secondary (holster stock in the way), outright disabling unfold…

When I design the mod I was hoping to add MP7 for my sniper build and a breacher shorty, so the size I need is 4. I was worried that some mod might alter pistol length so I just decide to enforce it. But I’ll make it a user toggle as well to tailor your need :-)

comments.author: Hakad
comments.body_html: Awesome! thank you for adding these functionality, although I still spot a small problem: If you physically remove the stock on a foldable weapon and put them in the holster, you can actually reattach the stock back onto that weapon, bypassing the limitation. BUT no worries though! functionalities that I want are in, I’m very happy with current state of the mod, thank you again for that!

One small bug I’ve noticed is that if you use Alt+Left click to equip a gun while both rifle slots are full the weapon automatically equips to the pistol slot, no matter the size or weapon type. Seems to work when size limits and server side weapon type restrictions are enabled.
